strings.scene.nansong.zongze.title: 过河
strings.scene.nansong.zongze.subtitle: 宗泽
strings.vo.01: 靖康之变后，宋高宗在南京应天府即位。六十九岁的宗泽受命为东京留守，回到残破的汴京。
strings.vo.02: 他修复城防，招抚四方的义军。河东王善拥众数十万，宗泽单骑到他营中，流着泪劝他为国效力，王善感泣而降。
strings.vo.03: 一个叫岳飞的年轻军官犯法当斩，宗泽一见，惊奇他的才能，把他放了，还授给他阵图。岳飞说：先布阵再交战，是兵法的常规；运用之妙，存乎一心。
strings.vo.04: 宗泽前后二十多次上疏，请高宗回到东京，号召北伐。高宗却一路南下到了扬州。
strings.vo.05: 建炎二年七月，宗泽背上生了毒疮。临终前他没有一句话说到家事——
strings.scene.nansong.zongze.fork.prompt: 过河——依《宋史》直书，还是听演义《说岳全传》？
strings.scene.nansong.zongze.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《宋史·宗泽传》《岳飞传》所载
strings.scene.nansong.zongze.canon.intro: 南宋的第一年，一位老人守着一座没有皇帝的都城，等着皇帝回来。
strings.scene.nansong.zongze.end.canon: 宗泽临终，吟诵杜甫“出师未捷身先死，长使英雄泪满襟”，连呼“过河”三声而卒。东京军民号恸。继任的杜充尽废其所为，义军星散，汴京不久沦陷。
strings.scene.nansong.zongze.legend.disclaimer: 以下取清钱彩《说岳全传》第十二回前后“夺状元枪挑小梁王”一节：小说写宗泽主持武举，岳飞在校场挑死与他争状元的小梁王柴桂，宗泽冒险保全岳飞。这是小说虚构，史书中宗泽识拔岳飞是在岳飞犯法当斩之时。另参照蔡东藩《宋史演义》第六十四回“宗留守力疾捐躯”。
strings.scene.nansong.zongze.legend.intro: 校场之上，小梁王柴桂横刀立马。主考官宗泽看着台下那个从汤阴来的年轻人，手心里全是汗。
strings.scene.nansong.zongze.end.legend: 小说里宗泽保下了状元，史书里宗泽留下了“过河”。
strings.scene.nansong.zongze.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若高宗还京（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：深蓝、米色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 南宋 · 宋建炎元年至二年（1127—1128 年）。临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。
setting.en: Southern Song (1127–1279), 1127 CE–1128 CE — Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.

shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–11 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞、烟；主体：盾墙｜动作：靖康之后的东京，城墙残破，街巷空寂｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；淡墨烟气横向飘散｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：风声｜屏幕文字：片名「过河」竖排书法与朱印「过河」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「靖康之变后，宋高宗在南京应天府即位。六十九岁的宗泽受命为东京留守，回到残破的汴京。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–11 s, 11 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, smoke; subject: shield wall | Action: After Jingkang, Kaifeng's walls are broken and its streets empty | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements; pale ink smoke drifting sideways | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「过河」 with vermilion seal 「过河」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「靖康之变后，宋高宗在南京应天府即位。六十九岁的宗泽受命为东京留守，回到残破的汴京。」

narration: 靖康之变后，宋高宗在南京应天府即位。六十九岁的宗泽受命为东京留守，回到残破的汴京。
他修复城防，招抚四方的义军。河东王善拥众数十万，宗泽单骑到他营中，流着泪劝他为国效力，王善感泣而降。
一个叫岳飞的年轻军官犯法当斩，宗泽一见，惊奇他的才能，把他放了，还授给他阵图。岳飞说：先布阵再交战，是兵法的常规；运用之妙，存乎一心。
宗泽前后二十多次上疏，请高宗回到东京，号召北伐。高宗却一路南下到了扬州。
建炎二年七月，宗泽背上生了毒疮。临终前他没有一句话说到家事——
宗泽临终，吟诵杜甫“出师未捷身先死，长使英雄泪满襟”，连呼“过河”三声而卒。东京军民号恸。继任的杜充尽废其所为，义军星散，汴京不久沦陷。
运用之妙，存乎一心。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Southern Song (1127–1279) · Cross the River: Zong Ze (「过河」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 77 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Southern Song (1127–1279), 1127 CE–1128 CE — Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.

Characters:
- Zong Ze (宗泽) — general, Nansong; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Yue Fei (岳飞) — general, Nansong; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Wang Shan (王善) — commoner, Nansong; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate
- Zhao Gou (赵构) — ruler, Nansong; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–11 s, 11 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, smoke; subject: shield wall | Action: After Jingkang, Kaifeng's walls are broken and its streets empty | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements; pale ink smoke drifting sideways | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: wind | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「过河」 with vermilion seal 「过河」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「靖康之变后，宋高宗在南京应天府即位。六十九岁的宗泽受命为东京留守，回到残破的汴京。」
Shot 2 (11–23 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Zong Ze, Wang Shan, cavalry | Action: A white-haired old man rides alone into the volunteers' camp | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; triangular tent shapes with vermilion lamp dots; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: crowd murmur; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他修复城防，招抚四方的义军。河东王善拥众数十万，宗泽单骑到他营中，流着泪劝他为国效力，王善感泣而降。」
Shot 3 (23–38 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Yue Fei, Zong Ze, sword | Action: At the execution ground a young officer is about to be beheaded | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: sword drawn | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「运用之妙，存乎一心。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「一个叫岳飞的年轻军官犯法当斩，宗泽一见，惊奇他的才能，把他放了，还授给他阵图。岳飞说：先布阵再交战，是兵法的常规；运用之妙，存乎一心。」
Shot 4 (38–48 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: 还京, scroll; subject: Zong Ze | Action: The old man writes his twentieth-odd petition urging the emperor to return | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宗泽前后二十多次上疏，请高宗回到东京，号召北伐。高宗却一路南下到了扬州。」
Shot 5 (48–56 s, 8 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river; subject: Zong Ze; dry-brush calligraphy 「过河」 | Action: On his sickbed he cries out three times: cross the river | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建炎二年七月，宗泽背上生了毒疮。临终前他没有一句话说到家事——」
Shot 6 (56–71 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Zong Ze | Action: Canonical outcome: Zong Ze dies reciting Du Fu and crying 'cross the river'; his successor undoes his work and Kaifeng is soon lost. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「宗泽临终，吟诵杜甫“出师未捷身先死，长使英雄泪满襟”，连呼“过河”三声而卒。东京军民号恸。继任的杜充尽废其所为，义军星散，汴京不久沦陷。」
Shot 7 (71–77 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「运用之妙，存乎一心。」 signed 《宋史·岳飞传》; vermilion seal 「过河」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「运用之妙，存乎一心。」

Sound: Music: xun clay ocarina, low and mournful, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: lingering wind after battle, crowd murmur, quiet room tone; SFX: wind, hoofbeats, sword drawn, bamboo slips rustling, war drums; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「过河」, subtitle 「宗泽」, vermilion seal 「过河」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「运用之妙，存乎一心。」 — 《宋史·岳飞传》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.nansong.liqingzhao.title: 金石录
strings.scene.nansong.liqingzhao.subtitle: 李清照
strings.vo.01: 李清照与丈夫赵明诚，在青州的归来堂里收集了满屋的金石书画。饭后烹茶，指着书堆说某事在某书某卷第几页第几行，猜中的先喝茶。
strings.vo.02: 靖康之变，金兵南下。他们选了书画中最好的，装了十五车南渡。留在青州的十几间屋子的书，被一把火烧了。
strings.vo.03: 建炎三年，赵明诚赴召湖州，在池阳江边与她分别。她问：如果城中有急事，怎么办？他回头说——
strings.vo.04: 那年八月，赵明诚病死于建康。此后她带着剩下的书画辗转于越州、明州、温州之间，书画一路散失、被盗。
strings.vo.05: 几年之后，她坐在灯下，翻开丈夫留下的《金石录》——
strings.scene.nansong.liqingzhao.quote: 独所谓宗器者，可自负抱，与身俱存亡，勿忘也。
strings.scene.nansong.liqingzhao.fork.prompt: 金石录——依《宋史》直书，还是听后世「再嫁之辩」？
strings.anchor.nandu: 李清照载书十五车南下
strings.scene.nansong.liqingzhao.pick.canon: 正史线 · 李清照《金石录后序》与《宋史·李格非传》所载
strings.scene.nansong.liqingzhao.canon.intro: 一位女词人带着几车书逃难。这一段的目标不是打赢谁，而是把书护住。
strings.scene.nansong.liqingzhao.end.canon: 李清照在后序中写道：三十四年之间，忧患得失，何其多也！然有有必有无，有聚必有散，乃理之常。《金石录》三十卷由她整理表上于朝，流传至今。
strings.scene.nansong.liqingzhao.legend.disclaim: 以下取宋人记载与清人辩说：南宋李心传《建炎以来系年要录》卷五十八、胡仔《苕溪渔隐丛话》等记载李清照于绍兴二年再嫁张汝舟，数月后告发其妄增举数而离异；清人俞正燮《癸巳类稿·易安居士事辑》等则力辩并无再嫁之事。这是持续数百年的学术争论，至今未有定论。
strings.scene.nansong.liqingzhao.legend.intro: 一封信写给了翰林学士綦崇礼：谢他在讼案中援手。几百年后，有人说这封信是伪作。
strings.scene.nansong.liqingzhao.end.legend: 再没再嫁，学者们争了几百年。后序里的那句“有聚必有散”，没有人争。
strings.scene.nansong.liqingzhao.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若书画全部保全（未开放）

背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：3×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触；3. 船行尾迹。
第 2 行：4. 水流笔迹；5. 墨滴下坠；6. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：1536×1024 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：深蓝、米色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.en: Southern Song (1127–1279), 1127 CE–1132 CE — Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.

narration: 李清照与丈夫赵明诚，在青州的归来堂里收集了满屋的金石书画。饭后烹茶，指着书堆说某事在某书某卷第几页第几行，猜中的先喝茶。
靖康之变，金兵南下。他们选了书画中最好的，装了十五车南渡。留在青州的十几间屋子的书，被一把火烧了。
建炎三年，赵明诚赴召湖州，在池阳江边与她分别。她问：如果城中有急事，怎么办？他回头说——
那年八月，赵明诚病死于建康。此后她带着剩下的书画辗转于越州、明州、温州之间，书画一路散失、被盗。
几年之后，她坐在灯下，翻开丈夫留下的《金石录》——
李清照在后序中写道：三十四年之间，忧患得失，何其多也！然有有必有无，有聚必有散，乃理之常。《金石录》三十卷由她整理表上于朝，流传至今。
独所谓宗器者，可自负抱，与身俱存亡，勿忘也。

镜头 6（56–71 秒，15 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；人物：李清照｜动作：正史结局：李清照在后序中写道：三十四年之间，忧患得失，何其多也！然有有必有无，有聚必有散，乃理之常。《金石录》三十卷由她整理表上于朝，流传至今。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「李清照在后序中写道：三十四年之间，忧患得失，何其多也！然有有必有无，有聚必有散，乃理之常。《金石录》三十卷由她整理表上于朝，流传至今。」
镜头 7（71–77 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「独所谓宗器者，可自负抱，与身俱存亡，勿忘也。」，下署《金石录后序·宋李清照撰》；右下角朱印「易安」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「独所谓宗器者，可自负抱，与身俱存亡，勿忘也。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：寂静室内、旷野风声、平缓河水、海浪；音效：琴声、车轮、马蹄声、摇橹；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「金石录」，副题「李清照」，朱印「易安」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「独所谓宗器者，可自负抱，与身俱存亡，勿忘也。」——《金石录后序·宋李清照撰》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Southern Song (1127–1279) · Records on Metal and Stone: Li Qingzhao (「金石录」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 77 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Southern Song (1127–1279), 1127 CE–1132 CE — Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.

Characters:
- Li Qingzhao (李清照) — scholar, Nansong; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing
- Zhao Mingcheng (赵明诚) — scholar, Nansong; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing
- Zhang Ruzhou (张汝舟) — commoner, Nansong; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–15 s, 15 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: palace pillars, scroll, palace eaves; subject: Li Qingzhao, Zhao Mingcheng | Action: In the Guilai Hall at Qingzhou the couple sit among books making tea | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; heavy ink pillars giving depth | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: guqin | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「金石录」 with vermilion seal 「易安」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「李清照与丈夫赵明诚，在青州的归来堂里收集了满屋的金石书画。饭后烹茶，指着书堆说某事在某书某卷第几页第几行，猜中的先喝茶。」
Shot 2 (15–27 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: scroll; subject: crowd | Action: Fifteen carts of books head south | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: wheels | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「靖康之变，金兵南下。他们选了书画中最好的，装了十五车南渡。留在青州的十几间屋子的书，被一把火烧了。」
Shot 3 (27–37 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: river, boat; subject: Zhao Mingcheng | Action: By the river at Chiyang her husband rides off, turning to give instructions | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「独所谓宗器者，可自负抱，与身俱存亡，勿忘也。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建炎三年，赵明诚赴召湖州，在池阳江边与她分别。她问：如果城中有急事，怎么办？他回头说——」
Shot 4 (37–49 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: sea, breaking waves, boat; subject: Li Qingzhao | Action: Alone she guards a few chests of books, drifting from town to town | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; broad wet-ink sea with white-paper wave crests; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: sea waves; SFX: oars | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「那年八月，赵明诚病死于建康。此后她带着剩下的书画辗转于越州、明州、温州之间，书画一路散失、被盗。」
Shot 5 (49–56 s, 7 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: 金石录; subject: Li Qingzhao; dry-brush calligraphy 「易安」 | Action: By lamplight she opens his manuscript and writes the afterword | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: guqin | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「几年之后，她坐在灯下，翻开丈夫留下的《金石录》——」
Shot 6 (56–71 s, 15 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Li Qingzhao | Action: Canonical outcome: In her afterword she reflects that what is gathered must scatter; she edits and presents the thirty-chapter Records on Metal and Stone. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「李清照在后序中写道：三十四年之间，忧患得失，何其多也！然有有必有无，有聚必有散，乃理之常。《金石录》三十卷由她整理表上于朝，流传至今。」
Shot 7 (71–77 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「独所谓宗器者，可自负抱，与身俱存亡，勿忘也。」 signed 《金石录后序·宋李清照撰》; vermilion seal 「易安」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「独所谓宗器者，可自负抱，与身俱存亡，勿忘也。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: quiet room tone, wind over open plains, calm river, sea waves; SFX: guqin, wheels, hoofbeats, oars; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「金石录」, subtitle 「李清照」, vermilion seal 「易安」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「独所谓宗器者，可自负抱，与身俱存亡，勿忘也。」 — 《金石录后序·宋李清照撰》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.nansong.huangtiandang.title: 黄天荡
strings.scene.nansong.huangtiandang.subtitle: 韩世忠与梁夫人
strings.vo.01: 建炎三年冬，金军渡江南下，一路追赶高宗，高宗只得泛海避敌。
strings.vo.02: 第二年春，兀术满载掳掠北归，到了镇江，却发现韩世忠的海船已经横截在江面上。
strings.vo.03: 韩世忠只有八千人，金军号称十万。两军在江上大战，韩世忠的夫人梁氏亲自擂鼓。
strings.vo.04: 金军被逼进黄天荡，四十八天出不去。兀术连夜派人掘开老鹳河故道，通往秦淮河。
strings.vo.05: 又有人给他献了一计：等到无风的日子——
strings.scene.nansong.huangtiandang.fork.prompt: 黄天荡——依《宋史》直书，还是听戏曲「梁红玉」？
strings.scene.nansong.huangtiandang.pick.canon: 正史 · 《宋史·韩世忠传》所载
strings.scene.nansong.huangtiandang.canon.intro: 建炎四年三月，镇江江面。韩世忠的海船一字排开，船头立着一面鼓。
strings.scene.nansong.huangtiandang.end.canon: 金军用火箭射海船帆篷，宋军大败，兀术得以北渡。此战虽未全功，却令金军从此不敢再轻易渡江。韩世忠因功拜检校少保。
strings.scene.nansong.huangtiandang.legend.discl: 以下取后世戏曲与蔡东藩《宋史演义》第六十七回。《宋史》只称“梁夫人”，“梁红玉”之名出自后世；京剧《战金山》等戏写她在金山擂鼓破敌，情节多有增饰。
strings.scene.nansong.huangtiandang.legend.intro: 戏里说，梁夫人在金山顶上擂鼓，金军往哪里冲，鼓点就往哪里转，宋军的船跟着鼓声包抄。
strings.scene.nansong.huangtiandang.end.legend: 戏台上的鼓声与史书上的桴鼓，是同一面鼓。
strings.scene.nansong.huangtiandang.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若兀术未能凿渠（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：深蓝、米色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 南宋 · 宋建炎四年三月至四月（1130 年三—四月）。临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。
setting.en: Southern Song (1127–1279), 1130 CE — Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.

characters.name: 韩世忠
characters.zh: 韩世忠（宋·浙西制置使）：展脚幞头，公服，褙子，宋式铠甲；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；以八千人扼守江面，与金军相持四十八日
characters.en: Han Shizhong (韩世忠) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand

characters.name: 梁夫人
characters.zh: 梁夫人（宋·韩世忠之妻）：展脚幞头，公服，褙子；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；亲执桴鼓督战；“红玉”之名出自后世
characters.en: Lady Liang (梁夫人) — royal / consort, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments

characters.name: 完颜宗弼
characters.zh: 完颜宗弼（金·兀术，金军统帅）：女真装束：辫发、左衽窄袖袍、貂帽；渡江追高宗不及，北归时被阻于江上
characters.en: Wanyan Zongbi (完颜宗弼) — general, Jin (Jurchen); Jurchen dress: braids, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, sable hat

characters.name: 献策者
characters.zh: 献策者（金·福建人王某）：女真装束：辫发、左衽窄袖袍、貂帽；为金军献无风时以火箭射海船之策
characters.en: Xian Cezhe (献策者) — commoner, Jin (Jurchen); Jurchen dress: braids, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, sable hat

shots.vo: 建炎三年冬，金军渡江南下，一路追赶高宗，高宗只得泛海避敌。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：河水、近山与地面、舟｜动作：镇江江面，金山与焦山之间｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：摇橹｜屏幕文字：片名「黄天荡」竖排书法与朱印「黄天荡」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「建炎三年冬，金军渡江南下，一路追赶高宗，高宗只得泛海避敌。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: river, near hills and ground, boat | Action: The river at Zhenjiang between Jinshan and Jiaoshan | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: oars | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「黄天荡」 with vermilion seal 「黄天荡」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建炎三年冬，金军渡江南下，一路追赶高宗，高宗只得泛海避敌。」

shots.vo: 第二年春，兀术满载掳掠北归，到了镇江，却发现韩世忠的海船已经横截在江面上。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（8–18 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：舟；主体：韩世忠、旌旗｜动作：韩世忠海船高大，横截江路｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾｜声音：环境：海浪；音效：号角｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「第二年春，兀术满载掳掠北归，到了镇江，却发现韩世忠的海船已经横截在江面上。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (8–18 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: boat; subject: Han Shizhong, banners | Action: Han Shizhong's tall seagoing ships block the river | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake | Sound: ambience: sea waves; SFX: horn | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「第二年春，兀术满载掳掠北归，到了镇江，却发现韩世忠的海船已经横截在江面上。」

shots.vo: 韩世忠只有八千人，金军号称十万。两军在江上大战，韩世忠的夫人梁氏亲自擂鼓。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（18–28 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：舟；主体：梁夫人、旌旗｜动作：梁夫人亲执桴鼓｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：急鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「韩世忠只有八千人，金军号称十万。两军在江上大战，韩世忠的夫人梁氏亲自擂鼓。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (18–28 s, 10 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: boat; subject: Lady Liang, banners | Action: Lady Liang beats the war drum herself | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: drum burst | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「韩世忠只有八千人，金军号称十万。两军在江上大战，韩世忠的夫人梁氏亲自擂鼓。」

shots.vo: 金军被逼进黄天荡，四十八天出不去。兀术连夜派人掘开老鹳河故道，通往秦淮河。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（28–38 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：远景：月；中景：河水；主体：众人｜动作：金军连夜凿渠三十里，通往秦淮｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；月轮留白，四周淡墨烘染；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「金军被逼进黄天荡，四十八天出不去。兀术连夜派人掘开老鹳河故道，通往秦淮河。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (28–38 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: background: moon; midground: river; subject: crowd | Action: Overnight the Jin army digs a thirty-li canal to the Qinhuai | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; moon left blank with pale wash around it; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「金军被逼进黄天荡，四十八天出不去。兀术连夜派人掘开老鹳河故道，通往秦淮河。」

shots.vo: 又有人给他献了一计：等到无风的日子——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（38–44 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：舟、烟；主体：火；飞白题字「黄天荡」｜动作：无风之日，火箭射向海船帆篷｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；泼墨成火，焰尖点朱砂；四角暗角收拢；热浪与烟气扭曲；画面定格成一幅水墨画｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：烈火｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「又有人给他献了一计：等到无风的日子——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (38–44 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: boat, smoke; subject: fire (splashed ink); dry-brush calligraphy 「黄天荡」 | Action: On a windless day fire arrows strike the ships' sails | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; splashed ink flames tipped with vermilion; vignette closing in from the corners; heat-haze and smoke distortion; freeze into a still ink painting | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: roaring fire | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「又有人给他献了一计：等到无风的日子——」

shots.vo: 金军用火箭射海船帆篷，宋军大败，兀术得以北渡。此战虽未全功，却令金军从此不敢再轻易渡江。韩世忠因功拜检校少保。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（44–57 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：金军用火箭射海船帆篷，宋军大败，兀术得以北渡。此战虽未全功，却令金军从此不敢再轻易渡江。韩世忠因功拜检校少保。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「金军用火箭射海船帆篷，宋军大败，兀术得以北渡。此战虽未全功，却令金军从此不敢再轻易渡江。韩世忠因功拜检校少保。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (44–57 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Fire arrows break the Song fleet and Wuzhu escapes north, but Jin never again crosses the river lightly. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「金军用火箭射海船帆篷，宋军大败，兀术得以北渡。此战虽未全功，却令金军从此不敢再轻易渡江。韩世忠因功拜检校少保。」

shots.zh: 镜头 7（57–63 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「黄天荡」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处
shots.en: Shot 7 (57–63 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「黄天荡」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

sound.zh: 背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：平缓河水、海浪、远处厮杀声、夜风；音效：摇橹、号角、急鼓、脚步声、烈火；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, sea waves, distant battle, night wind; SFX: oars, horn, drum burst, footsteps, roaring fire; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

narration: 建炎三年冬，金军渡江南下，一路追赶高宗，高宗只得泛海避敌。
第二年春，兀术满载掳掠北归，到了镇江，却发现韩世忠的海船已经横截在江面上。
韩世忠只有八千人，金军号称十万。两军在江上大战，韩世忠的夫人梁氏亲自擂鼓。
金军被逼进黄天荡，四十八天出不去。兀术连夜派人掘开老鹳河故道，通往秦淮河。
又有人给他献了一计：等到无风的日子——
金军用火箭射海船帆篷，宋军大败，兀术得以北渡。此战虽未全功，却令金军从此不敢再轻易渡江。韩世忠因功拜检校少保。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】南宋 · 黄天荡（韩世忠与梁夫人）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 63 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：深蓝、米色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。

时代与场景：南宋 · 宋建炎四年三月至四月（1130 年三—四月）。临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。

人物：
- 韩世忠（宋·浙西制置使）：展脚幞头，公服，褙子，宋式铠甲；武将甲胄披挂，佩剑或执兵器；以八千人扼守江面，与金军相持四十八日
- 梁夫人（宋·韩世忠之妻）：展脚幞头，公服，褙子；宫廷华服，发髻首饰精致；亲执桴鼓督战；“红玉”之名出自后世
- 完颜宗弼（金·兀术，金军统帅）：女真装束：辫发、左衽窄袖袍、貂帽；渡江追高宗不及，北归时被阻于江上
- 献策者（金·福建人王某）：女真装束：辫发、左衽窄袖袍、貂帽；为金军献无风时以火箭射海船之策

分镜：
镜头 1（0–8 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：河水、近山与地面、舟｜动作：镇江江面，金山与焦山之间｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：摇橹｜屏幕文字：片名「黄天荡」竖排书法与朱印「黄天荡」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「建炎三年冬，金军渡江南下，一路追赶高宗，高宗只得泛海避敌。」
镜头 2（8–18 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：舟；主体：韩世忠、旌旗｜动作：韩世忠海船高大，横截江路｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾｜声音：环境：海浪；音效：号角｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「第二年春，兀术满载掳掠北归，到了镇江，却发现韩世忠的海船已经横截在江面上。」
镜头 3（18–28 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：舟；主体：梁夫人、旌旗｜动作：梁夫人亲执桴鼓｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：急鼓｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「韩世忠只有八千人，金军号称十万。两军在江上大战，韩世忠的夫人梁氏亲自擂鼓。」
镜头 4（28–38 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：远景：月；中景：河水；主体：众人｜动作：金军连夜凿渠三十里，通往秦淮｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；月轮留白，四周淡墨烘染；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：脚步声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「金军被逼进黄天荡，四十八天出不去。兀术连夜派人掘开老鹳河故道，通往秦淮河。」
镜头 5（38–44 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：舟、烟；主体：火；飞白题字「黄天荡」｜动作：无风之日，火箭射向海船帆篷｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；泼墨成火，焰尖点朱砂；四角暗角收拢；热浪与烟气扭曲；画面定格成一幅水墨画｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：烈火｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「又有人给他献了一计：等到无风的日子——」
镜头 6（44–57 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：金军用火箭射海船帆篷，宋军大败，兀术得以北渡。此战虽未全功，却令金军从此不敢再轻易渡江。韩世忠因功拜检校少保。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「金军用火箭射海船帆篷，宋军大败，兀术得以北渡。此战虽未全功，却令金军从此不敢再轻易渡江。韩世忠因功拜检校少保。」
镜头 7（57–63 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文；右下角朱印「黄天荡」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处

声音：背景乐：铜鼓，庄重原始，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：平缓河水、海浪、远处厮杀声、夜风；音效：摇橹、号角、急鼓、脚步声、烈火；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「黄天荡」，副题「韩世忠与梁夫人」，朱印「黄天荡」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Southern Song (1127–1279) · Huangtiandang: Han Shizhong and Lady Liang (「黄天荡」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 63 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Southern Song (1127–1279), 1130 CE — Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.

Characters:
- Han Shizhong (韩世忠) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Lady Liang (梁夫人) — royal / consort, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments
- Wanyan Zongbi (完颜宗弼) — general, Jin (Jurchen); Jurchen dress: braids, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, sable hat
- Xian Cezhe (献策者) — commoner, Jin (Jurchen); Jurchen dress: braids, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, sable hat

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–8 s, 8 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: river, near hills and ground, boat | Action: The river at Zhenjiang between Jinshan and Jiaoshan | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: oars | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「黄天荡」 with vermilion seal 「黄天荡」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「建炎三年冬，金军渡江南下，一路追赶高宗，高宗只得泛海避敌。」
Shot 2 (8–18 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: boat; subject: Han Shizhong, banners | Action: Han Shizhong's tall seagoing ships block the river | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake | Sound: ambience: sea waves; SFX: horn | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「第二年春，兀术满载掳掠北归，到了镇江，却发现韩世忠的海船已经横截在江面上。」
Shot 3 (18–28 s, 10 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: boat; subject: Lady Liang, banners | Action: Lady Liang beats the war drum herself | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: drum burst | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「韩世忠只有八千人，金军号称十万。两军在江上大战，韩世忠的夫人梁氏亲自擂鼓。」
Shot 4 (28–38 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: background: moon; midground: river; subject: crowd | Action: Overnight the Jin army digs a thirty-li canal to the Qinhuai | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; moon left blank with pale wash around it; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「金军被逼进黄天荡，四十八天出不去。兀术连夜派人掘开老鹳河故道，通往秦淮河。」
Shot 5 (38–44 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: boat, smoke; subject: fire (splashed ink); dry-brush calligraphy 「黄天荡」 | Action: On a windless day fire arrows strike the ships' sails | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; splashed ink flames tipped with vermilion; vignette closing in from the corners; heat-haze and smoke distortion; freeze into a still ink painting | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: roaring fire | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「又有人给他献了一计：等到无风的日子——」
Shot 6 (44–57 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Fire arrows break the Song fleet and Wuzhu escapes north, but Jin never again crosses the river lightly. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「金军用火箭射海船帆篷，宋军大败，兀术得以北渡。此战虽未全功，却令金军从此不敢再轻易渡江。韩世忠因功拜检校少保。」
Shot 7 (57–63 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「黄天荡」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: bronze drums, solemn and primal, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, sea waves, distant battle, night wind; SFX: oars, horn, drum burst, footsteps, roaring fire; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「黄天荡」, subtitle 「韩世忠与梁夫人」, vermilion seal 「黄天荡」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

strings.scene.nansong.yuefei.subtitle: 岳飞
strings.vo.01: 绍兴十年，金人撕毁和议，兀术率军南下。
strings.vo.02: 岳飞奉命北伐，连复颍昌、蔡州诸地，进驻郾城。
strings.vo.03: 兀术以精锐骑兵来攻。岳飞令步卒持麻扎刀入阵，不许仰视，只砍马足。
strings.vo.04: 郾城、颍昌两战大捷。正当此时，朝廷一日之内连发金字牌，命他班师。
strings.scene.nansong.yuefei.fork.prompt: 精忠——依《宋史》直书，还是听野史《岳母刺字》？
strings.scene.nansong.yuefei.canon.intro: 绍兴十年夏，金军撕毁和约南下。岳飞自鄂州出兵，前锋已进抵郾城。
strings.scene.nansong.yuefei.end.canon: 岳飞班师，所复之地复失。次年被诬下狱，与岳云、张宪同遇害。韩世忠质问秦桧，秦桧答：其事体莫须有。
strings.scene.nansong.yuefei.legend.disclaimer: 以下是后世传说与清代小说《说岳全传》的情节。《宋史》只载岳飞背上涅有“尽忠报国”四字，并未说是其母所刺。朱仙镇之捷，《宋史》本传据岳珂所编家传载入，小说又大加铺陈，今人考证多以为有夸饰。
strings.scene.nansong.yuefei.legend.intro: 传说岳飞从军前，母亲在他背上刺下“精忠报国”四字。小说又写岳家军在朱仙镇大破金兵。
strings.scene.nansong.yuefei.end.legend: 字留在背上，故事留在小说里。传说汇回正史：岳飞班师，含冤而死。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：深蓝、米色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 南宋 · 宋绍兴十年至十一年（1140—1142 年）。临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。
setting.en: Southern Song (1127–1279), 1140 CE–1142 CE — Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.

shots.vo: 绍兴十年，金人撕毁和议，兀术率军南下。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–6 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：远山；中景：河水、草｜动作：中原故土，黄河南岸｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：旷野风声｜屏幕文字：片名「精忠」竖排书法与朱印「精忠」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「绍兴十年，金人撕毁和议，兀术率军南下。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–6 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: river, grass | Action: The lost heartland south of the Yellow River | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「精忠」 with vermilion seal 「精忠」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「绍兴十年，金人撕毁和议，兀术率军南下。」

shots.vo: 岳飞奉命北伐，连复颍昌、蔡州诸地，进驻郾城。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（6–12 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：主体：完颜宗弼、骑兵、旌旗｜动作：金人毁约南下｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）｜声音：环境：草原风；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「岳飞奉命北伐，连复颍昌、蔡州诸地，进驻郾城。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (6–12 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Wanyan Zongbi, cavalry, banners | Action: Jin breaks the treaty and marches south | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: steppe wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「岳飞奉命北伐，连复颍昌、蔡州诸地，进驻郾城。」

shots.vo: 兀术以精锐骑兵来攻。岳飞令步卒持麻扎刀入阵，不许仰视，只砍马足。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（12–21 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：手持式轻微震动，节奏急促｜构图：主体：岳飞、骑兵、长枪｜动作：郾城：拐子马｜水墨效果：墨迹溅开切入；马蹄踏处墨点四溅；墨点四散（如马蹄踏墨）；兵刃金属寒光一闪｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：兵刃相击、号角｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「兀术以精锐骑兵来攻。岳飞令步卒持麻扎刀入阵，不许仰视，只砍马足。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (12–21 s, 9 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Yue Fei, cavalry, spear | Action: Yancheng: the linked cavalry | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter; ink spatters where hooves strike; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink; a cold metallic glint on the blade | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: clashing weapons, horn | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「兀术以精锐骑兵来攻。岳飞令步卒持麻扎刀入阵，不许仰视，只砍马足。」

shots.vo: 郾城、颍昌两战大捷。正当此时，朝廷一日之内连发金字牌，命他班师。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（21–29 秒，8 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：卷轴；主体：宋高宗、战马｜动作：一日之中，十二道金字牌｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：马蹄声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「郾城、颍昌两战大捷。正当此时，朝廷一日之内连发金字牌，命他班师。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (21–29 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: scroll; subject: Song Gaozong, war horse | Action: Twelve golden tablets in a single day | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「郾城、颍昌两战大捷。正当此时，朝廷一日之内连发金字牌，命他班师。」

shots.vo: 岳飞面向东方，再拜——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（29–35 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：主体：岳；飞白题字「班师」｜动作：班师｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；四角暗角收拢；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：战后余风；音效：号角｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「岳飞面向东方，再拜——」

narration: 绍兴十年，金人撕毁和议，兀术率军南下。
岳飞奉命北伐，连复颍昌、蔡州诸地，进驻郾城。
兀术以精锐骑兵来攻。岳飞令步卒持麻扎刀入阵，不许仰视，只砍马足。

strings.scene.nansong.caishi.title: 采石矶
strings.scene.nansong.caishi.subtitle: 虞允文
strings.vo.01: 金主亮的大军已到江北。守江的王权弃军先逃，被罢了官，接替的李显忠还没赶到。
strings.vo.02: 中书舍人虞允文奉命到采石犒师。他看见宋军三五成群，解下马鞍坐在路边，没有人统领。
strings.vo.03: 有人劝他：你是来犒师的，不是来督战的，何必担这个责任？
strings.vo.04: 虞允文说：危及社稷，我将何处逃避？他召集诸将，宣示朝廷恩赏，约定一同死战。
strings.vo.05: 江北的高台上，金主亮挥动了小红旗——
strings.scene.nansong.caishi.fork.prompt: 采石矶——依《宋史》直书，还是听赋《海鳅赋》？
strings.scene.nansong.caishi.pick.canon: 正史 · 《宋史·虞允文传》所载
strings.scene.nansong.caishi.canon.intro: 绍兴三十一年十一月，采石。一个文官骑马来到江边，身后只有几个随从。江北，金军的旗帜一眼望不到头。
strings.scene.nansong.caishi.end.canon: 金军渡江受挫，死伤甚众。次日宋军又在上游焚其舟船。金主亮转往扬州，欲从瓜洲渡江，不久在营中被部将所杀。南宋转危为安。
strings.scene.nansong.caishi.legend.disclaimer: 以下取南宋杨万里《海鳅赋》的描写，并参照蔡东藩《宋史演义》第七十八回。杨万里文中写到宋军的海鳅船与霹雳炮，赋体文字有铺张渲染，不同于战报。
strings.scene.nansong.caishi.legend.intro: 杨万里写道：宋军的战船藏在江边，人在船中踏车而行，船快如飞，金军根本看不见是什么在驱动它。
strings.scene.nansong.caishi.end.legend: 赋中的霹雳与史书中的捷报，落在同一片江面上。
strings.scene.nansong.caishi.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若虞允文只犒师不督战（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：深蓝、米色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 南宋 · 宋绍兴三十一年十一月（1161 年十一月）。临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。
setting.en: Southern Song (1127–1279), 1161 CE — Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.

shots.vo: 金主亮的大军已到江北。守江的王权弃军先逃，被罢了官，接替的李显忠还没赶到。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：皴法山石；中景：河水、近山与地面｜动作：采石矶，长江最窄处之一｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：浪击｜屏幕文字：片名「采石矶」竖排书法与朱印「采石」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「金主亮的大军已到江北。守江的王权弃军先逃，被罢了官，接替的李显忠还没赶到。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: textured rocks; midground: river, near hills and ground | Action: Caishi, one of the narrowest points of the Yangtze | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: crashing waves | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「采石矶」 with vermilion seal 「采石」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「金主亮的大军已到江北。守江的王权弃军先逃，被罢了官，接替的李显忠还没赶到。」

shots.vo: 中书舍人虞允文奉命到采石犒师。他看见宋军三五成群，解下马鞍坐在路边，没有人统领。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（10–20 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：营帐；主体：虞允文、众人｜动作：散兵三五成群，解鞍坐在路旁｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；营帐三角墨块，灯火点朱｜声音：环境：旷野风声；音效：低语｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「中书舍人虞允文奉命到采石犒师。他看见宋军三五成群，解下马鞍坐在路边，没有人统领。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (10–20 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Yu Yunwen, crowd | Action: Scattered soldiers sit by the road, saddles off | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular tent shapes with vermilion lamp dots | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「中书舍人虞允文奉命到采石犒师。他看见宋军三五成群，解下马鞍坐在路边，没有人统领。」

narration: 金主亮的大军已到江北。守江的王权弃军先逃，被罢了官，接替的李显忠还没赶到。
中书舍人虞允文奉命到采石犒师。他看见宋军三五成群，解下马鞍坐在路边，没有人统领。
有人劝他：你是来犒师的，不是来督战的，何必担这个责任？
虞允文说：危及社稷，我将何处逃避？他召集诸将，宣示朝廷恩赏，约定一同死战。
江北的高台上，金主亮挥动了小红旗——
金军渡江受挫，死伤甚众。次日宋军又在上游焚其舟船。金主亮转往扬州，欲从瓜洲渡江，不久在营中被部将所杀。南宋转危为安。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Southern Song (1127–1279) · Caishi Cliff: Yu Yunwen (「采石矶」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 63 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Southern Song (1127–1279), 1161 CE — Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.

Characters:
- Yu Yunwen (虞允文) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- Shi Jun (时俊) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Wanyan Liang (完颜亮) — ruler, Jin (Jurchen); Jurchen dress: braids, left-lapel narrow-sleeved robe, sable hat
- Wang Quan (王权) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand

strings.scene.nansong.xinqiji.title: 五十骑
strings.scene.nansong.xinqiji.subtitle: 辛弃疾
strings.vo.01: 金主亮南侵前后，山东义军蜂起。济南人辛弃疾聚众两千，投奔耿京，做了掌书记。
strings.vo.02: 有个和尚义端偷了耿京的大印逃走。辛弃疾追了上去，把他斩了，带着印回来。
strings.vo.03: 绍兴三十二年，辛弃疾奉耿京之命南下建康，向朝廷奉表归附。高宗召见了他。
strings.vo.04: 他北返到海州，才得知张安国、邵进已经杀了耿京，投降金人。
strings.vo.05: 他对众人说：我奉主帅之命归朝，没想到出了这样的变故，回去怎么复命？
strings.scene.nansong.xinqiji.fork.prompt: 五十骑——依《宋史》直书，还是听词《鹧鸪天》？
strings.scene.nansong.xinqiji.pick.canon: 正史 · 《宋史·辛弃疾传》所载
strings.scene.nansong.xinqiji.canon.intro: 海州城外，消息传来时，辛弃疾刚刚从建康北返。耿京死了，张安国带着部众投了金营。
strings.scene.nansong.xinqiji.end.canon: 张安国正与金将饮酒，被辛弃疾等当众缚走，金将追之不及。辛弃疾把他押到建康，斩于市。洪迈后来为辛弃疾作记，说他赤手领五十骑，缚取于五万众中。
strings.scene.nansong.xinqiji.legend.disclaimer: 以下取辛弃疾晚年《鹧鸪天》（壮岁旌旗拥万夫）中对少年往事的追忆。词作写于南归多年之后，是回望，不是实录。
strings.scene.nansong.xinqiji.legend.intro: 许多年后，有客人来访，慨然谈起功名。辛弃疾想起少年时的事，写下一首词：壮岁的旌旗，锦衣的骑兵渡江而来。
strings.scene.nansong.xinqiji.end.legend: 少年的五十骑与白发的词人，是同一个人。
strings.scene.nansong.xinqiji.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若辛弃疾留在北方（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：深蓝、米色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 南宋 · 宋绍兴三十二年（1162 年）。临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。

narration: 金主亮南侵前后，山东义军蜂起。济南人辛弃疾聚众两千，投奔耿京，做了掌书记。
有个和尚义端偷了耿京的大印逃走。辛弃疾追了上去，把他斩了，带着印回来。
绍兴三十二年，辛弃疾奉耿京之命南下建康，向朝廷奉表归附。高宗召见了他。
他北返到海州，才得知张安国、邵进已经杀了耿京，投降金人。
他对众人说：我奉主帅之命归朝，没想到出了这样的变故，回去怎么复命？
张安国正与金将饮酒，被辛弃疾等当众缚走，金将追之不及。辛弃疾把他押到建康，斩于市。洪迈后来为辛弃疾作记，说他赤手领五十骑，缚取于五万众中。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Southern Song (1127–1279) · Fifty Horsemen: Xin Qiji (「五十骑」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 67 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Southern Song (1127–1279), 1162 CE — Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.

Characters:
- Xin Qiji (辛弃疾) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing
- Zhang Anguo (张安国) — commoner, Yijun; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate
- Yi Duan (义端) — commoner, Yijun; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate
- Wang Shilong (王世隆) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Geng Jing (耿京) — general, Yijun; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: army tents, near hills and ground; subject: banners | Action: Geng Jing's rebel camp in Shandong | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; triangular tent shapes with vermilion lamp dots | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「五十骑」 with vermilion seal 「稼轩」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「金主亮南侵前后，山东义军蜂起。济南人辛弃疾聚众两千，投奔耿京，做了掌书记。」
Shot 2 (10–19 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; subject: Xin Qiji, Yi Duan, war horse | Action: Yiduan steals the seal and flees; Xin Qiji rides after him alone | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; moon left blank with pale wash around it | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「有个和尚义端偷了耿京的大印逃走。辛弃疾追了上去，把他斩了，带着印回来。」
Shot 3 (19–28 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves, scroll; subject: Xin Qiji | Action: At Jiankang Emperor Gaozong receives Xin Qiji | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; heavy ink pillars giving depth | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「绍兴三十二年，辛弃疾奉耿京之命南下建康，向朝廷奉表归附。高宗召见了他。」
Shot 4 (28–36 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Wang Shilong, Xin Qiji | Action: Terrible news from Haizhou: Geng Jing is dead | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; triangular tent shapes with vermilion lamp dots | Sound: ambience: camp drums; SFX: murmuring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他北返到海州，才得知张安国、邵进已经杀了耿京，投降金人。」
Shot 5 (36–45 s, 9 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Zhang Anguo, fire (splashed ink), crowd; dry-brush calligraphy 「五十骑」 | Action: In the Jin camp Zhang Anguo is drinking | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; triangular tent shapes with vermilion lamp dots; splashed ink flames tipped with vermilion; vignette closing in from the corners; heat-haze and smoke distortion; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他对众人说：我奉主帅之命归朝，没想到出了这样的变故，回去怎么复命？」
Shot 6 (45–61 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Zhang Anguo | Action: Canonical outcome: Xin Qiji seizes Zhang Anguo amid fifty thousand men and has him executed at Jiankang. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「张安国正与金将饮酒，被辛弃疾等当众缚走，金将追之不及。辛弃疾把他押到建康，斩于市。洪迈后来为辛弃疾作记，说他赤手领五十骑，缚取于五万众中。」
Shot 7 (61–67 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「稼轩」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: dizi flute, clear and lyrical, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, night wind, palace hall reverb, camp drums; SFX: hoofbeats, bamboo slips rustling, murmuring; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「五十骑」, subtitle 「辛弃疾」, vermilion seal 「稼轩」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.nansong.diaoyucheng.title: 钓鱼城
strings.scene.nansong.diaoyucheng.subtitle: 上帝折鞭
strings.vo.01: 蒙古南下四川，平原诸城难以坚守。四川制置使余玠采播州冉氏兄弟之策，依山筑城。
strings.vo.02: 合州钓鱼山三面临江，城建在山上，易守难攻。
strings.vo.03: 开庆元年，蒙古大汗蒙哥亲率大军围攻钓鱼城，守将王坚坚守不降。
strings.vo.04: 从春至夏，蒙军屡攻不下，军中疫病流行。
strings.scene.nansong.diaoyucheng.fork.prompt: 钓鱼城——依《宋史》直书，还是听异说「蒙哥之死」？
strings.scene.nansong.diaoyucheng.canon.intro: 开庆元年二月，合州钓鱼山下。蒙哥汗亲率大军到了，山上的城门紧闭。
strings.scene.nansong.diaoyucheng.end.canon: 蒙哥死于钓鱼城下，蒙军北撤。钓鱼城此后坚守二十年，直到宋亡之后才开城降元。
strings.scene.nansong.diaoyucheng.legend.disclai: 以下是史料之间的分歧：蒙哥是病死，还是在钓鱼城下中炮石受伤而死？各种记载说法不一。
strings.scene.nansong.diaoyucheng.legend.intro: 《元史》说蒙哥崩于钓鱼山；有的记载说他死于疾疫，有的说他在城下被炮石所伤。后人称此城为“上帝折鞭处”。
strings.scene.nansong.diaoyucheng.end.legend: 死因成了悬案，结局却是一样的：蒙哥死，蒙军北撤。
strings.scene.nansong.diaoyucheng.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若钓鱼城失守（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：深蓝、米色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

narration: 蒙古南下四川，平原诸城难以坚守。四川制置使余玠采播州冉氏兄弟之策，依山筑城。
合州钓鱼山三面临江，城建在山上，易守难攻。
开庆元年，蒙古大汗蒙哥亲率大军围攻钓鱼城，守将王坚坚守不降。

七月——
蒙哥死于钓鱼城下，蒙军北撤。钓鱼城此后坚守二十年，直到宋亡之后才开城降元。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Southern Song (1127–1279) · Diaoyu Fortress: Where the Scourge of God Broke His Whip (「钓鱼城」)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 52 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Southern Song (1127–1279), 1243 CE–1279 CE — Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.

Characters:
- Yu Jie (余玠) — minister, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents
- Ran Jin (冉琎) — scholar, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing
- Wang Jian (王坚) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand
- Möngke (蒙哥) — ruler, Mongol; Mongol dress: braids, jisun robe, bowl-shaped hat, leather boots
- Wang Li (王立) — general, Song; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains, textured rocks; midground: river | Action: Hezhou, where three rivers meet | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: calm river | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「钓鱼城」 with vermilion seal 「钓鱼城」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「蒙古南下四川，平原诸城难以坚守。四川制置使余玠采播州冉氏兄弟之策，依山筑城。」
Shot 2 (10–16 s, 6 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: map scroll; subject: Ran Jin, Yu Jie | Action: The Ran brothers propose a chain of mountain forts | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「合州钓鱼山三面临江，城建在山上，易守难攻。」
Shot 3 (16–24 s, 8 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: subject: Möngke, army ranks, forest of spears, cavalry | Action: Möngke leads the siege himself | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; rows of pale ink figures fading into distance; dense dry-brush verticals like a forest of spears; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: distant drums | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「开庆元年，蒙古大汗蒙哥亲率大军围攻钓鱼城，守将王坚坚守不降。」
Shot 4 (24–30 s, 6 s) | Camera: subtle handheld shake, urgent rhythm | Composition: subject: Wang Jian, ink burst, bow | Action: Summer night, stones from the catapults | Ink FX: cut in on an ink splatter | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: cannon fire, rain of arrows | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「从春至夏，蒙军屡攻不下，军中疫病流行。」
Shot 5 (30–36 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: fire (splashed ink); dry-brush calligraphy 「折鞭」 | Action: Death of the Great Khan | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; splashed ink flames tipped with vermilion; vignette closing in from the corners; heat-haze and smoke distortion; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: lingering wind after battle; SFX: cannon fire | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「七月——」
Shot 6 (36–46 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Möngke dies at Diaoyu and the Mongols withdraw; the fortress holds for twenty years and surrenders only after the Song falls. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「蒙哥死于钓鱼城下，蒙军北撤。钓鱼城此后坚守二十年，直到宋亡之后才开城降元。」
Shot 7 (46–52 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「钓鱼城」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: dizi flute, clear and lyrical, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, wind over open plains, distant battle, night wind, lingering wind after battle; SFX: bamboo slips rustling, distant drums, cannon fire, rain of arrows; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「钓鱼城」, subtitle 「上帝折鞭」, vermilion seal 「钓鱼城」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets

strings.scene.nansong.jiasidao.title: 半闲堂
strings.scene.nansong.jiasidao.subtitle: 贾似道
strings.vo.01: 开庆元年，忽必烈围鄂州。贾似道私下派使者宋京到蒙古营中请和，答应称臣纳岁币。恰好蒙哥汗死于钓鱼城下，忽必烈急于北归。
strings.vo.02: 贾似道回朝后，隐瞒讲和之事，只说诸路大捷。理宗以为他有再造之功。
strings.vo.03: 度宗即位，尊他为师臣，许他十日一朝。他住在西湖葛岭的赐第，筑半闲堂，常和姬妾趴在地上斗蟋蟀。
strings.vo.04: 襄阳被围五年，他把告急文书压下不报。有一天度宗问：听说襄阳围了三年了？他说：蒙古兵早已退了，陛下从哪里听来的？
strings.vo.05: 德祐元年二月，他不得已亲自出征，在丁家洲——
strings.scene.nansong.jiasidao.fork.prompt: 半闲堂——依《宋史》直书，还是听笔记与民谣「蟋蟀宰相」？
strings.anchor.ezhou: 鄂州之围，贾似道私遣使请和
strings.scene.nansong.jiasidao.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《宋史·奸臣传》所载
strings.scene.nansong.jiasidao.canon.intro: 这一段的玩法是“查账”：把贾似道报上去的“捷报”与真实战况一一对照。
strings.scene.nansong.jiasidao.end.canon: 丁家洲一战，宋军十三万溃散。贾似道被贬循州，途中在漳州木绵庵为监押官郑虎臣所杀。一年后，元军入临安。
strings.scene.nansong.jiasidao.pick.legend: 笔记与民谣 · 蟋蟀宰相
strings.scene.nansong.jiasidao.legend.disclaimer: 以下取旧题贾似道撰的《促织经》（实为后人辑补）与宋末流传的西湖民谣“朝中无宰相，湖上有平章”，以及蔡东藩《宋史演义》第九十五至九十七回对贾似道的敷演。“蟋蟀宰相”是后世的讥称。
strings.scene.nansong.jiasidao.legend.intro: 半闲堂里，一只黑头金翅的蟋蟀刚刚斗赢了第七场。门外有人通报：襄阳的信使到了。
strings.scene.nansong.jiasidao.end.legend: 蟋蟀斗赢了，襄阳丢了。民谣传遍了临安。
strings.scene.nansong.jiasidao.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若鄂州和议公开（未开放）

中国水墨写意素材图（场景环境），题材：半闲堂·贾似道（1259—1275 年）。
画风：写意水墨，焦墨—浓墨—淡墨分层次，枯笔飞白与泼墨墨点飞溅，笔触边缘自然晕开；点缀色（用量克制，只作点睛）：黑色 #1a1a1a、深蓝色 #3950c0、米色 #ebdcc9。
背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：4×4 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 远山（淡墨）；2. 近坡（中墨）；3. 土坡地线；4. 草丛（枯笔）。
第 2 行：5. 大江水面；6. 白色飞白浪花；7. 涟漪；8. 屋舍内景。
第 3 行：9. 竹简书卷；10. 灯烛；11. 案几；12. 城墙雉堞。
第 4 行：13. 月；14. 殿柱；15. 屋檐；16. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：2048×2048 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：深蓝、米色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained deep blue and beige accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 南宋 · 宋开庆元年至德祐元年（1259—1275 年）。临安西湖、江上水军、山城、书斋。
setting.en: Southern Song (1127–1279), 1259 CE–1275 CE — Lin'an and West Lake, river navies, mountain citadels, scholar studios.

characters.name: 贾似道
characters.zh: 贾似道（南宋·右丞相、平章军国重事）：展脚幞头，公服，褙子；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；老年；鄂州私和，隐匿军情，晚年于葛岭半闲堂斗蟋蟀
characters.en: Jia Shidao (贾似道) — minister, Nansong; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; elderly

characters.name: 忽必烈
characters.zh: 忽必烈（蒙古·蒙古宗王，后为元世祖）：蒙古装束：辫发、质孙袍、钹笠帽、皮靴；围鄂州，闻蒙哥死讯北还
characters.en: Kublai (忽必烈) — ruler, Mongol; Mongol dress: braids, jisun robe, bowl-shaped hat, leather boots

characters.name: 赵禥
characters.zh: 赵禥（南宋·宋度宗）：展脚幞头，公服，褙子，宋式铠甲；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；倚重贾似道
characters.en: Zhao Qi (赵禥) — ruler, Nansong; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence

characters.name: 郑虎臣
characters.zh: 郑虎臣（南宋·监押官）：展脚幞头，公服，褙子，宋式铠甲；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；押送贾似道至漳州木绵庵，杀之
characters.en: Zheng Huchen (郑虎臣) — commoner, Nansong; long-winged futou caps, official robes, beizi jackets, Song-style armour; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate

shots.vo: 开庆元年，忽必烈围鄂州。贾似道私下派使者宋京到蒙古营中请和，答应称臣纳岁币。恰好蒙哥汗死于钓鱼城下，忽必烈急于北归。
shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–14 秒，14 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：中景：城墙雉堞、河水、舟；主体：军阵、长兵如林｜动作：鄂州城下，蒙古大军围城，江上舟楫往来｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入；焦墨勾出城垛轮廓；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：战鼓｜屏幕文字：片名「半闲堂」竖排书法与朱印「半闲」；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「开庆元年，忽必烈围鄂州。贾似道私下派使者宋京到蒙古营中请和，答应称臣纳岁币。恰好蒙哥汗死于钓鱼城下，忽必烈急于北归。」
shots.en: Shot 1 (0–14 s, 14 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: midground: crenellated city wall, river, boat; subject: army ranks, forest of spears | Action: Mongol armies besiege Ezhou; boats crisscross the river | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper; scorched-ink outline of battlements; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: war drums | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「半闲堂」 with vermilion seal 「半闲」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「开庆元年，忽必烈围鄂州。贾似道私下派使者宋京到蒙古营中请和，答应称臣纳岁币。恰好蒙哥汗死于钓鱼城下，忽必烈急于北归。」

shots.vo: 贾似道回朝后，隐瞒讲和之事，只说诸路大捷。理宗以为他有再造之功。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（14–23 秒，9 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：月；中景：河水、舟｜动作：一个使者乘小舟，悄悄驶向北岸的敌营｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；水墨流动晕染｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：摇橹｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「贾似道回朝后，隐瞒讲和之事，只说诸路大捷。理宗以为他有再造之功。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (14–23 s, 9 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; midground: river, boat | Action: An envoy slips across to the enemy camp by small boat | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: oars | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「贾似道回朝后，隐瞒讲和之事，只说诸路大捷。理宗以为他有再造之功。」

shots.vo: 度宗即位，尊他为师臣，许他十日一朝。他住在西湖葛岭的赐第，筑半闲堂，常和姬妾趴在地上斗蟋蟀。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（23–34 秒，11 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：贾似道、众人｜动作：西湖葛岭，半闲堂里，一群人趴在地上斗蟋蟀｜水墨效果：墨点放大化入本镜；重墨立柱，空间纵深｜声音：环境：鸟鸣；音效：蟋蟀｜屏幕文字：引文「此军国重事邪？」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「度宗即位，尊他为师臣，许他十日一朝。他住在西湖葛岭的赐第，筑半闲堂，常和姬妾趴在地上斗蟋蟀。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (23–34 s, 11 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: Jia Shidao, crowd | Action: At Banxian Hall on West Lake men lie on the floor fighting crickets | Ink FX: an ink dot expands into the shot; heavy ink pillars giving depth | Sound: ambience: birdsong; SFX: crickets | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「此军国重事邪？」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「度宗即位，尊他为师臣，许他十日一朝。他住在西湖葛岭的赐第，筑半闲堂，常和姬妾趴在地上斗蟋蟀。」

shots.vo: 襄阳被围五年，他把告急文书压下不报。有一天度宗问：听说襄阳围了三年了？他说：蒙古兵早已退了，陛下从哪里听来的？
shots.zh: 镜头 4（34–47 秒，13 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：告急、卷轴；主体：盾墙｜动作：襄阳城被围五年，告急文书堆在案头无人拆封｜水墨效果：沿画卷横向延展接入｜声音：环境：寂静室内；音效：竹简翻动｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「襄阳被围五年，他把告急文书压下不报。有一天度宗问：听说襄阳围了三年了？他说：蒙古兵早已退了，陛下从哪里听来的？」
shots.en: Shot 4 (34–47 s, 13 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: 告急, scroll; subject: shield wall | Action: Five years of siege at Xiangyang; urgent reports pile up unopened | Ink FX: continues sideways like an unrolling scroll | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: bamboo slips rustling | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「襄阳被围五年，他把告急文书压下不报。有一天度宗问：听说襄阳围了三年了？他说：蒙古兵早已退了，陛下从哪里听来的？」

shots.vo: 德祐元年二月，他不得已亲自出征，在丁家洲——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（47–53 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：河水、舟；主体：军阵、长兵如林；飞白题字「半闲」｜动作：丁家洲江面，十三万宋军不战而溃｜水墨效果：浓墨泼满画面后切入；湿笔横扫成水纹，墨在水中化开；舟影一笔带过，水痕拖尾；四角暗角收拢；水墨流动晕染；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：远处厮杀声；音效：城门闭合｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「德祐元年二月，他不得已亲自出征，在丁家洲——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (47–53 s, 6 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river, boat; subject: army ranks, forest of spears; dry-brush calligraphy 「半闲」 | Action: At Dingjiazhou 130,000 Song troops scatter without fighting | Ink FX: ink floods the frame, then cut; wet horizontal strokes forming ripples, ink dissolving in water; a boat in one stroke with a trailing wake; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: distant battle; SFX: gate slamming shut | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「德祐元年二月，他不得已亲自出征，在丁家洲——」

shots.vo: 丁家洲一战，宋军十三万溃散。贾似道被贬循州，途中在漳州木绵庵为监押官郑虎臣所杀。一年后，元军入临安。
shots.zh: 镜头 6（53–65 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：丁家洲一战，宋军十三万溃散。贾似道被贬循州，途中在漳州木绵庵为监押官郑虎臣所杀。一年后，元军入临安。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「丁家洲一战，宋军十三万溃散。贾似道被贬循州，途中在漳州木绵庵为监押官郑虎臣所杀。一年后，元军入临安。」
shots.en: Shot 6 (53–65 s, 12 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: Canonical outcome: Jia Sidao is banished and killed on the road by his escort; a year later the Yuan enter Lin'an. | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「丁家洲一战，宋军十三万溃散。贾似道被贬循州，途中在漳州木绵庵为监押官郑虎臣所杀。一年后，元军入临安。」

shots.vo: 此军国重事邪？
shots.zh: 镜头 7（65–71 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「此军国重事邪？」，下署《宋史·奸臣传·贾似道》；右下角朱印「半闲」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「此军国重事邪？」
shots.en: Shot 7 (65–71 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「此军国重事邪？」 signed 《宋史·奸臣传·贾似道》; vermilion seal 「半闲」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「此军国重事邪？」

sound.zh: 背景乐：琵琶，铿锵急切或婉转低回，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：远处厮杀声、夜风、鸟鸣、寂静室内；音效：战鼓、摇橹、蟋蟀、竹简翻动、城门闭合；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: pipa lute, tense tremolo or wistful phrases, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: distant battle, night wind, birdsong, quiet room tone; SFX: war drums, oars, crickets, bamboo slips rustling, gate slamming shut; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「半闲堂」，副题「贾似道」，朱印「半闲」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「此军国重事邪？」——《宋史·奸臣传·贾似道》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。
onScreenText.en: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「半闲堂」, subtitle 「贾似道」, vermilion seal 「半闲」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「此军国重事邪？」 — 《宋史·奸臣传·贾似道》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.
